question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Gregarious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Solitary)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Gregarious"** refers to someone who enjoys the company of others and is sociable. (सामाजिक)
 
 
• **Example:** John is gregarious and loves spending time with his friends at social gatherings.
 
 
• The word **"Solitary"** means someone who prefers to be alone, avoiding social interactions. (एकाकी)
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day at work, Sarah enjoys a solitary walk in the park to clear her mind.
